false_cognates.why: route-distinguisher vs route-target: both carry 'route-', but an RD makes a VRF's routes unique while an RT controls import/export; distinct concepts, each with its own true partner (n.rd<->d.rd, n.rt<->d.rt).
routing-policy vs service-policy: both carry 'policy', but a route import/export filter vs a QoS policy-map; n.rtpolicy's true partner is d.routepolicy, d.qospolicy's is n.qos.
ce-neighbor vs bgp-neighbor: both carry 'neighbor', but a customer-edge peer across an access vs an iBGP session between PEs in the core; n.ce's true partner is d.ce and d.ibgp is a native gap.
